trap.label: what vs that
trap.wrong: What is more staff that we need.
trap.right: It is more staff that we need.
trap.why: O brasileiro mistura as duas estruturas. Clivada: It is X that…; pseudo: What we need is X.

mcq.q: It is more staff ___ we need.

opts: What worries me is the deadline.
What the deadline worries me is.

fix.wrong: What we need that is staff.
It is staff what we need.
fix.right: It is staff that we need.

fix.wrong: What worries me are the deadline.
fix.right: What worries me is the deadline.

rewrite.answer: What worries me is the deadline.
It is the deadline that worries me.
What we need is more staff.
